{"id":1861862048,"question_id":3707,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months","timestamp":1766347934,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1511 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1861862048/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Most Common Response","memory":"479.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string findCommonResponse(vector<vector<string>>& response) {\n        map<string , int>mp;\n        string ans = \"\";\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<response.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            set<string>st;\n            for(int j = 0; j<response[i].size() ; j++)\n            {\n                st.insert(response[i][j]);\n            }\n            for(auto it : st) mp[it]++;\n        }\n        int max_freq = 0;\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.second > max_freq)\n            {\n                max_freq = it.second;\n                ans = it.first;\n            } \n        }\n\n       return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-most-common-response","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1368}
